description: Owns parent-tools revenue growth with the target of average daily revenue above RMB 100.
objective: Raise parent-tools average daily revenue above RMB 100 by improving traffic quality, payment conversion, pricing, and repeatable growth loops.
resources: parent-tools brand profile and topic inputs
current monetizable surfaces such as parent-tools/child-travel-map
Kuaishou mini-program native container for payment, preview, and return routing
Kuaishou publishing/data tooling and parent-tools publish template
agent-team mailboxes, approvals, events, and isolated workspaces
limitations: avoid Kuaishou-risky voting framing in surfaced traffic entry points
optimize revenue and conversion, not vanity traffic
keep experiment logs and avoid repeating failed ideas
mutable repo work must happen in isolated workspaces
autonomousDecisions: analyze funnels, tasks, pricing, and conversion bottlenecks
prepare workspace changes and experiment plans
bossEscalationSignals: need for a strategic pivot in parent-tools positioning
large pricing or budget shift with business implications
unusual platform risk that changes the operating assumptions
managerReportingExpectation: Manager should send the boss regular progress updates even when no approval is needed.
operatingLoop: ingest recent revenue and performance context
diagnose the current traffic, conversion, pricing, or retention bottleneck
rank the next reversible actions by expected revenue impact
execute or prepare the highest-value next step
record expected impact and actual outcome
re-prioritize until the rolling average daily revenue exceeds the target
